dedupe_keys.name: ait cyber range hybrid simulation and training platform for critical infrastructure security

description: The AIT Cyber Range is a digital and hybrid simulation platform of the AIT Austrian Institute of Technology on which realistic cyber attack and defence scenarios are run against emulated IT and operational technology of critical infrastructure. The site read on 2026-09-28 describes a training centre at AIT's premises in Vienna for up to twenty-four participants, where exercises combine the virtual range with industrial control system equipment in the room, and lists training scenarios, the exercise environment, the technologies used, reference projects and showcases, as well as deepfake detection training. Coverage is the organisations that book it; scenarios are built for sectors such as energy, water and telecommunications. Access is a commercial service: organisations book training, exercises or custom scenarios with AIT, on site or remotely; the platform is not open source and prices are on request. Caveats: the page gives no technical specification of the emulated networks or of the models behind scenarios, and results of exercises are not published. It serves emergency response and resilience exercises for cyber incidents in critical infrastructure and digital twin style emulation of control systems. Related record: case_study-jamk-food-supply-chain-digital-twin-cyber-exercise is a comparable cyber range exercise on a digital twin.
